retrievalProfile.description: A hazy, atmospheric composition featuring a soft-focus central shadow and high-contrast geometric typography anchored at the top.
triggerTerms: geometric sans-serif header with drop shadow

recipe.visualDefinition: A minimalist, atmospheric design characterized by a soft, desaturated blue-to-grey gradient background, a central horizontal blurred shadow element with a warm orange glow at one end, and a prominent geometric sans-serif title at the top left.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between sharp, structured typography and soft, blurred imagery
Horizontal alignment of the central shadow mirroring the top text line
Subtle warm-to-cool color tension between the orange glow and blue mist
coreInvariants: Heavy soft-focus blur on all background elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A horizontal, blurred shadow occupies the upper-middle third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, geometric title in the top left corner provides the primary structural anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the sharp text at the top left, down to the blurred central shadow, and then across the vast negative space at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive negative space in the lower half creates a sense of depth and isolation.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted, desaturated blue-grey gradient for the background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Dark indigo/charcoal for the central shadow and text fill.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Soft, glowing orange/red at the tip of the shadow and for secondary vertical text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation throughout, with high value contrast between the text and the light mist.

characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'E' features three equal-length horizontal bars
The 'Y' has a high, wide crotch

treatment.shadow: subtle offset drop shadow in a lighter tone

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used for the main title, paired with vertical calligraphic elements for contrast.
graphicDevices: Subtle drop shadow on text to lift it from the mist
Vertical text orientation for secondary elements

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric circularity and wide proportions.
Provides the necessary geometric skeleton and sharp terminals.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a soft, airbrushed gradient background transitioning from a light misty blue at the bottom to a slightly darker grey-blue at the top. In the upper-middle section, place a horizontal, highly blurred dark shadow that looks like a floating object, with a soft orange-red glow at its rightmost tip.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place the title in the top left corner using a wide geometric sans-serif font in uppercase. Apply a subtle, light-colored drop shadow to the text to make it pop against the hazy background.

verificationChecks: Is the background sufficiently blurred and misty?
Is the text perfectly geometric and wide-tracked?
Does the orange glow feel integrated into the shadow?
Is there a clear sense of depth created by the negative space?

mustRedesign: Do not replicate the exact Japanese characters
Ensure the shadow shape is abstract and not a recognizable object
postGenerationChecks: Check for smooth color transitions without banding
Verify the text is legible against the mist
Ensure the shadow does not look like a specific person or animal
Confirm the overall mood is calm and ethereal
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a soft-focus airbrushed background with a high-contrast geometric header to create a sense of 'structured atmosphere'.
